title: Key West, FL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Key West, FL: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Key West is a city in FL with a population of 26,444. Southernmost Point with conch culture, sunsets, and no state income tax in paradise. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 11b growing zone supports Very hot — tropical fruits, multiple growing cycles. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.5.
